models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Light NW pattern over the islands now, but departure is 12 days out - nothing in this payload reaches the trip dates.
briefing.synopsis: Through 21-22 Sep the Aeolians sit under a light north-westerly flow: 3-8 kt across all six islands, seas 0.3-1.2 ft (ECMWF IFS 0.25 and ECMWF AIFS, both 21 Sep 00Z; waves cross-checked against ECMWF WAM 0.25 21 Sep 00Z and Meteo-France MFWAM 20 Sep 12Z). By the early hours of 23 Sep the wind backs into the E/NE - 8-11 kt at Panarea and Stromboli with interval-maximum gusts of 21-24 kt at Panarea, Stromboli and Filicudi - and the sea builds modestly, to 2.0 ft total and 1.9 ft swell at Filicudi by midday 23 Sep. The models' own data ends 27 Sep 23:00, so anything about early October is outside this briefing entirely.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: Tonight the fleet is at Portorosa Marina, which scores as fully sheltered - an enclosed basin with all-round protection, and the choice does not matter here. Local conditions are benign: 5.5 kt from the WNW at 18:00 easing to 5.0 kt WSW by midnight, with 0.2-0.3 ft of sea (ECMWF IFS 0.25, 21 Sep 00Z). Nothing in the payload would give any reason to shift berth.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: For 22 Sep the models diverge more than usual at 06:00 at both Portorosa and Lipari - Portorosa 2.5-8.6 kt and Lipari 3.1-9.9 kt against a consensus near 5-6 kt from the WSW/WNW - so treat the mean as soft rather than settled (ECMWF IFS 0.25 and ECMWF AIFS, 21 Sep 00Z). Seas stay small, 0.5-0.8 ft at 06:00 building to about 1.0-1.2 ft by midday. Any morning departure window is unconstrained by wind at these numbers, but this is a dry-run day, not a trip day.

passage_notes.leg: Portorosa - Lipari (rehearsed 22 Sep; real date 4 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Rehearsal scores go, 6.9 kt broad reach, 06:00 start. Indicative only.

passage_notes.leg: Lipari - Panarea (rehearsed 23 Sep; real date 5 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Go, 9.8 kt close hauled. Panarea sees gusts to 21.6 kt at 06:00 on 23 Sep.

passage_notes.leg: Lipari - Stromboli, optional (rehearsed 24 Sep; real date 5 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Go, 1.6 kt - effectively a motoring day. The 5 kt gust flag is a light-air artefact.

passage_notes.leg: Stromboli - Panarea, optional return (rehearsed 25 Sep; real date 6 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Go, 5.2 kt close hauled; 18 kt interval-maximum gust from a single model against a 5 kt mean, not treated as a caution.

passage_notes.leg: Panarea - Filicudi (rehearsed 26 Sep; real date 7 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Go at 11.6 kt broad reach, but flagged as deteriorating after 07:00 - early start in the rehearsal.

passage_notes.leg: Filicudi - Salina (rehearsed 27 Sep; real date 8 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Only caution in the set: 13.9 kt head to wind, gusts 29 kt, wind against swell giving a short steep sea; deteriorates after 08:00.

cautions: The rehearsal verdicts are the real legs scored against this week's live weather, not forecasts for 4-8 October. Do not plan around them.

Filicudi Porto scores only workable on the rehearsed night of 26 Sep (ENE 15 kt straight in, 1.8 ft N swell wrapping); Pecorini a Mare scores sheltered. This is the one berth in the set where the choice genuinely matters.
Marina del Gabbiano at Stromboli is open from every direction - shelter there depends entirely on it staying calm, whatever the date.
ICON-2i runs only about 60-72 h ahead and drops out of any longer-range view; MFWAM here is a 20 Sep 12Z run, 23.1 h old.
briefing.confidence_note: Run-to-run stability is excellent in the near term - mean wind shifts of only 0.6-0.9 kt out to 120 h across 14 snapshots - but the trip dates lie a week beyond the 27 Sep 23:00 end of every model in this payload, so confidence for the flotilla itself is low by definition rather than through model disagreement.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
